summary: Found at first ComfyUI boot on the rented Mac Mini M4 during the 1.3.0 macOS validation run (MPI-391 section C).

Picked up under MPI-450 Gate A. The card's premise was WRONG and is corrected in validation.md: ComfyUI falls back to Latent2RGB when a decoder is missing, so previews were never absent - they were the blocky colour-blob kind, on every platform for FLUX.2 Klein and Wan 2.2 (both newer than the ComfyUI portable bundle that supplies vae_approx), and on macOS/Linux for everything (the uv path git-clones ComfyUI, which carries no vae_approx). Four decoders uploaded to R2 and added as engineAssets. The LTX/taehv strand stays out of scope.

Built. Four decoders uploaded to R2 under vision/models/vae_approx/ and HEAD-verified live, added as engineAssets: taesdxl + taef1 (bakedOnPod, sha matches the Pod Dockerfile byte for byte), taef2 for FLUX.2 Klein (DERIVED from the official combined file and proved by a strict load into TAESD(latent_channels=128) plus a real decode), lighttaew2_2 for Wan 2.2 (byte-identical upstream, keeps a real mirrorUrl). No yamlHelper edit needed - the vae_approx folder key derives from the filename. Two tests added, both negative-controlled; suite 441 pass. Maturity validating: needs one Klein and one Wan generation to see the preview quality change.
